name: Icy platinum blonde
client: A very pale, cool blonde from root to tip with no yellow warmth. It is bright and striking, and it needs regular toning to stay icy.
stylist: Full lightening to a pale, even base, then a violet-blue toner for a cool finish. Plan regrowth care, toner refreshes and bond protection.
prompt_spec: an icy platinum blonde all over, from root to ends, a very light cool silvery-white blonde with no yellow, even and glossy at the roots, through the mid-lengths and at the ends

name: Platinum blonde with a soft root shadow
client: Bright platinum lengths with a softly deeper root, so regrowth looks planned and the colour grows out gently.
stylist: Lighten the lengths to a pale base and tone to platinum, then smudge a muted ash-beige root shadow to soften the regrowth line.
prompt_spec: a platinum blonde with a soft root shadow: the roots a muted ash-beige that blends smoothly into pale platinum through the mid-lengths, with the ends a bright cool platinum, the transition soft and soft

name: Pearl blonde gloss
client: A soft, shiny pearly blonde tone that freshens lighter hair and calms brassy warmth. It leaves a glassy finish.
stylist: A toning gloss over hair that is already light, to even the tone and add shine: pearly beige with a faint violet reflect. Refresh the gloss as the tone fades.
prompt_spec: light blonde hair with a soft pearl gloss all over: roots, mids and ends all the same creamy pearl blonde with a soft beige-violet sheen, shiny and even, with no yellow

name: Champagne babylights
client: Very fine, creamy champagne lights woven through the hair. They give a soft, sun-kissed glow and grow out easily.
stylist: Micro-fine weaves from close to the root through the top and sides, toned to a creamy gold-beige. The base shows between the fine lights, so regrowth is soft.
prompt_spec: very fine champagne-blonde babylights woven from close to the roots to the ends all over the head, over a dark blonde base that shows between them, creamy gold-beige and subtle, soft all-over brightness rather than stripes

name: Honey blonde foil highlights
client: Woven honey-gold highlights that add warm, bright dimension across the whole head.
stylist: Foiled weaves from near the root with a softened start, toned to a clear golden honey rather than brass. Suits clients who are happy to keep up root visits.
prompt_spec: honey blonde foil highlights woven through the whole head from close to the roots to the ends over a light brown base, evenly spaced warm golden-honey strands with the brown showing between them, clear and bright

name: Golden blonde foilayage with a root shadow
client: Painted golden blonde that brightens towards the ends. The softer root lets it grow out gently.
stylist: Foilayage gives stronger lift than open-air balayage, with a dark-blonde root smudge to blend the regrowth. Tone to a clear gold, not brass.
prompt_spec: a soft dark-blonde root shadow at the roots melting into golden blonde through the mid-lengths and a bright, clear golden blonde at the ends, hand-painted and softly blended, warm and luminous

name: Ash blonde with a root shadow
client: A cool, smoky ash blonde with a deeper root that keeps the colour looking soft and grown-in.
stylist: Lighten to a pale, even base and tone to ash, with a muted dark-blonde root shadow. Ash fades towards warmth, so plan toner refreshes.
prompt_spec: a smoky dark-blonde root shadow at the roots blending into cool ash blonde through the mid-lengths and a lighter ash blonde at the ends, a cool smoky blonde with no yellow or gold

name: Vanilla blonde sombre
client: A gentle step from your natural root to soft, creamy vanilla blonde at the ends. It looks natural and grows out with little fuss.
stylist: A soft gradient lightening a few levels towards the ends, toned to a warm-neutral cream. Keep the root natural for low upkeep.
prompt_spec: dark blonde at the roots, softly blending into a beige blonde through the mid-lengths and creamy vanilla blonde at the ends, a gentle gradient with no hard line

name: Strawberry blonde balayage
client: Light blonde with a touch of copper-pink warmth, hand-painted through the lengths.
stylist: Hand-painted balayage in a light blonde with copper-pink warmth, heavier at the ends. A gloss keeps the warmth clear; warm tones fade faster.
prompt_spec: light brown at the roots, then hand-painted strawberry blonde through the mid-lengths and a lighter, rosier strawberry blonde at the ends, soft and blended, a warm peachy glow

name: Sandy blonde lights and lowlights
client: A natural sandy blonde with fine lighter and deeper strands that give depth without a bold change.
stylist: Fine sandy babylights with a few dark-blonde lowlights between them for depth, in muted, slightly warm tones. Lowlights add depth only on hair that is already dark blonde or lighter; on light brown the person's own colour gives the depth.
prompt_spec: natural sandy blonde dimension over a dark blonde base: fine light sandy-blonde strands woven from close to the roots to the ends, with a few deeper dark-blonde strands between them, muted and natural, no stripes

name: Champagne money piece
client: Bright, creamy sections at the front frame the face while the rest of your colour stays as it is.
stylist: Face-framing sections lightened to a creamy champagne beige, heavier at the front and finer behind. A contained service that suits a refresh.
prompt_spec: light brown hair at the roots, mids and ends, with bright creamy champagne-blonde sections at the front hairline framing the face on both sides, heaviest at the front and finer behind

name: Bronde balayage
client: A blend of brown and blonde: brown at the root, with soft golden-beige through the lengths.
stylist: Balayage that keeps a brown root and moves through bronde to a soft beige blonde, toned neutral to warm. Gloss to keep it from turning brassy.
prompt_spec: a brown base at the roots, blending into a brown-and-blonde bronde through the mid-lengths and soft beige blonde at the ends, hand-painted, multi-tonal and soft

name: Mushroom blonde colour melt
client: A muted, ash-beige colour that melts from a deeper root into a soft grey-toned blonde with no hard lines.
stylist: Lighten the lengths to a pale, even base, then melt a mushroom-brown root into mushroom blonde through the lengths. Cool, muted tones; a gloss helps hold the cool cast.
prompt_spec: a muted mushroom-brown root melting smoothly into soft ash-beige mushroom blonde through the mid-lengths and a lighter, muted mushroom blonde at the ends, no lines, cool and muted

name: Beige blonde colour correction
client: A colourist-led plan for blonde that has turned brassy, patchy or uneven. The aim is an even, soft beige blonde.
stylist: Assessment-led correction towards an even neutral beige blonde, which may involve neutralising or removing earlier colour first. Agree the plan after a strand test.
prompt_spec: an even, soft beige blonde all over, the same neutral tone from root to ends with no brassy yellow, orange patches or bands, smooth and healthy-looking

name: Chestnut brown refresh
client: A tone-on-tone refresh that revives warm chestnut brown and adds shine without a big change.
stylist: A demi-permanent refresh over the whole head or lengths to renew depth and warmth. It fades gradually, without a hard regrowth line.
prompt_spec: rich warm chestnut brown all over, with the roots, mids and ends all the same glossy red-gold brown, shiny, healthy-looking and even, with no banding

name: Soft caramel-brown babylights
client: Your brown stays rich and natural, with fine caramel strands that catch the light.
stylist: Fine caramel babylights through the top and sides over a natural mocha base. Soft regrowth and low contrast.
prompt_spec: mocha brown hair with very fine caramel-brown babylights woven from close to the roots to the ends, the brown showing between them, a subtle golden shimmer, low contrast

name: Caramel and golden-brown balayage
client: Warm caramel painted through rich chocolate brown, softly brighter at the ends.
stylist: Hand-painted balayage with a soft root, caramel through the mids and a golden brown at the ends. Gloss to keep the warmth glossy.
prompt_spec: rich chocolate brown at the roots, softly blending into warm caramel brown through the mid-lengths and a brighter golden-brown at the ends, hand-painted and softly blended

name: Soft milk-chocolate and caramel balayage
client: A natural-looking warmth on very dark brown hair, kept soft so the contrast stays gentle.
stylist: A restrained lift on a very dark base, aiming for milk chocolate through the mids and a caramel brown at the ends. Keep the root dark and plan toning.
prompt_spec: very dark espresso brown at the roots, softly warming into milk-chocolate brown through the mid-lengths and a gentle caramel brown at the ends, natural and understated, no stark contrast

name: Cool ash brown
client: A cool, smoky brown for a calm, modern finish.
stylist: An all-over cool brown with a grey-green or blue-violet reflect. Ash fades towards warmth, so a gloss helps hold the tone.
prompt_spec: a cool ash brown all over, roots, mids and ends the same smoky brown with a cool reflect, no red or orange warmth, even and glossy

name: Milk chocolate sombre
client: A very soft step from your root to a lighter, warm brown at the ends, with no hard lines.
stylist: A subtle gradient over a warm-neutral brown, lifting the ends a little towards caramel. Low contrast, grows out gently.
prompt_spec: warm milk-chocolate brown at the roots, then milk-chocolate brown through the mid-lengths, softly lightening to caramel brown at the ends, a very subtle gradient

name: Cinnamon brown foilayage
client: Warm brown with a hint of copper, painted brighter through the ends for a glow in the light.
stylist: Painted and wrapped sections for a little more lift than open balayage, in a warm copper-tinged brown with a golden brown at the ends.
prompt_spec: natural brown at the roots, then a warm, spicy cinnamon brown through the mid-lengths and a lighter golden brown at the ends, painted sections that glow in the light

name: Caramel to honey ombre
client: A clear, graceful fade from a brown root into warm caramel and light honey at the ends.
stylist: A defined gradient from the mid-lengths with the natural root zone left, caramel moving to honey at the ends. The ends take the most lightening, so check their condition; a toning gloss keeps the warmth clear.
prompt_spec: rich chocolate brown at the roots and upper lengths, with a clear, smooth gradient into warm caramel brown through the mid-lengths and a light honey blonde at the ends, a visible but soft fade

name: Chocolate and caramel colour melt
client: Brown that moves from deep chocolate to warm caramel in one smooth, soft blend.
stylist: Blend a chocolate root through milk chocolate to caramel at the ends. Tones sit close together so the transition is soft.
prompt_spec: deep chocolate brown roots melting smoothly into milk-chocolate brown through the mid-lengths and warm caramel brown at the ends, no lines or stripes, a continuous soft gradient

name: Deep brown shine gloss
client: A rich, glassy gloss that deepens very dark brown and brings out its shine.
stylist: A clear or tinted gloss to even the tone and add reflect on very dark brown hair. A simple colour refresh with little change in shade.
prompt_spec: a neutral deep dark brown, nearly black, all over from root to ends, rich and very glossy with a smooth light-catching shine

name: Chocolate brown colour correction
client: A colourist-led plan for patchy, banded or off-tone dyed hair. The aim is an even, rich brown.
stylist: Assessment-led correction towards an even chocolate brown, which may involve removing earlier colour, pre-filling lighter or porous sections, or neutralising tone first. Agree the plan after a strand test.
prompt_spec: an even, rich chocolate brown all over, the same glossy neutral-warm chocolate brown from root to ends with no patches, bands or orange or green cast

name: Copper balayage with a root shadow
client: A warm copper that glows through the lengths, over a soft brown root so it grows out gently.
stylist: A chestnut root shadow with balayage moving from auburn through the mids to a brighter copper at the ends. Copper fades fast, so plan glosses.
prompt_spec: a soft chestnut-brown root shadow at the roots, melting into warm auburn through the mid-lengths and a brighter copper at the ends, a hand-painted, softly blended copper balayage

name: Auburn all over
client: A rich brown with a clear red warmth, even from root to tip.
stylist: An all-over auburn at a brown level, warm and slightly red. Red-leaning tones fade faster, so a gloss helps the shine.
prompt_spec: a rich auburn all over, with the roots, mids and ends all the same warm auburn carrying a clear red warmth, glossy, healthy-looking and even, with no banding

name: Copper all over
client: A bright, warm orange-red copper from root to ends.
stylist: An all-over bright copper. On natural hair near a copper level the colour lifts and tones together; earlier dye needs its own plan, because colour does not lift colour. It fades quickly, so plan gloss visits and gentle care.
prompt_spec: a bright warm copper all over, with the roots, mids and ends all the same bright natural orange-red copper, glossy, healthy-looking and even, with no banding

name: Ginger balayage
client: Golden-orange ginger painted softly through the lengths, bright at the ends.
stylist: Balayage from copper through the mids to a light golden-orange ginger at the ends, with the natural root left. It needs lightening and warm tones fade, so plan glosses.
prompt_spec: light brown at the roots, then a warm copper through the mid-lengths and a light golden-orange ginger at the ends, hand-painted and soft, bright and warm

name: Cherry cola gloss
client: A dark brown with a flash of cherry red that shows in the light.
stylist: A tinted gloss to add cherry-red reflect to a dark brown base. Subtle indoors, richer in sunlight. Refresh as it fades.
prompt_spec: a dark brown all over with a rich cherry-red reflect, roots, mids and ends all the same, glossy and subtle, red showing in the light

name: Mahogany refresh
client: A deep brown with a red-violet depth, refreshed so it looks rich and glossy.
stylist: A demi-permanent refresh to renew a red-violet brown. Depth and shine with a gentle fade and no hard regrowth line.
prompt_spec: a deep mahogany brown all over with a red-violet depth, with the roots, mids and ends all the same, rich, glossy, healthy-looking and even, with no banding

name: Copper money piece
client: Your auburn stays as it is, with brighter copper sections at the front that frame the face.
stylist: Face-framing sections lightened to copper over an auburn base, heavier at the front. Gloss keeps the brightness from fading.
prompt_spec: auburn brown at the roots, mids and ends, with bright warm copper sections at the front hairline framing the face on both sides, heaviest at the front and finer behind

name: Copper ombre
client: A graceful fade from auburn into bright copper at the ends.
stylist: A defined gradient from the mid-lengths, auburn moving to copper. The natural root zone stays, so regrowth is easy.
prompt_spec: natural auburn-brown at the roots and upper lengths, then auburn through the mid-lengths in a clear, smooth gradient to a bright copper at the ends

name: Auburn to ginger colour melt
client: Warm tones that melt from auburn through copper to a light ginger in one smooth blend.
stylist: Blend auburn at the root into copper mids and ginger ends, with no demarcation. Warm tones fade fast, so plan glosses.
prompt_spec: auburn brown roots melting smoothly into warm copper through the mid-lengths and a light golden-orange ginger at the ends, no lines or stripes, a continuous glowing gradient

name: Soft black shine gloss
client: A deep, soft black with a glassy finish that gives dark hair real shine.
stylist: A gloss over black or very dark hair to even the tone and add reflect. Neutral to slightly warm black with no lightening.
prompt_spec: a soft neutral black all over, roots, mids and ends the same, deep and very glossy with a smooth light-catching shine

name: Jet black all over
client: A solid, cool jet black from root to ends. It is a long-term choice, because black is hard to lighten later.
stylist: An all-over cool jet black. A strong colour that is hard to lighten later, so confirm the long-term plan first.
prompt_spec: a solid, cool jet black all over, roots, mids and ends the same, deep and even with a glassy neutral shine and no blue or red cast

name: Mocha money piece
client: Soft black hair with a lighter mocha brown around the face to brighten it gently.
stylist: Face-framing sections lifted to a mocha brown over natural black, heavier at the front. A restrained contrast that suits dark hair; lifting dyed black is a correction and needs its own plan.
prompt_spec: soft black hair at the roots, mids and ends, with soft mocha-brown sections at the front hairline framing the face on both sides, a restrained gentle contrast

name: Black to burgundy colour melt
client: Black at the root that deepens into a dark, rich wine tone at the ends, subtle until it catches the light.
stylist: Melt a soft black root through a dark cherry to a deep burgundy at the ends. Dark enough to stay wearable, with a red-violet sheen.
prompt_spec: soft black roots melting smoothly into a dark cherry-brown through the mid-lengths and a deep burgundy wine at the ends, subtle until the light catches it, soft

name: Silver white
client: A cool, bright white-silver from root to tip. The hair is lightened to its palest first, and it needs regular toning to stay silver.
stylist: Full lightening to a very pale base, then a cool silver toner. High upkeep: plan regrowth care, toner refreshes and bond protection.
prompt_spec: a cool silvery-white all over, with the roots, mids and ends all the same bright white-silver, no yellow anywhere, smooth, glossy and even, with no banding

name: Charcoal grey
client: A dark, cool grey with a smoky, modern depth.
stylist: Lighten to a pale enough base that the grey reads as grey rather than ash brown, then deposit a dark cool-neutral grey. Grey tones fade and warm up, so plan toning.
prompt_spec: a dark, cool charcoal grey all over, roots, mids and ends the same smoky grey with a faint blue cast, even and glossy

name: Grey blending with blonde
client: Soft blonde lights and deeper strands that merge with your natural grey. Regrowth shows less, and the grey looks planned.
stylist: Fine lights and dark-blonde lowlights around the root zone and through the surface to blend natural grey. Low-contrast and suits longer gaps between visits.
prompt_spec: dark blonde hair with my own natural grey, if any, in its existing amount and distribution, blended with fine blonde lights and a few deeper dark-blonde lowlights woven from the roots to the ends, so the grey, blonde and deeper strands merge with no regrowth line, soft and low contrast

review.note: The front view shows the blended grey more clearly than the back view.

name: Grey blending with brown
client: Brown strands and soft lights that blend with your natural grey for a lived-in look and an easy grow-out.
stylist: Brown lowlights and lights that merge with the grey, instead of covering it. Reduces the contrast at the root and suits a gradual approach.
prompt_spec: brown hair with my own natural grey, if any, in its existing amount and distribution, blended with fine light-brown strands and a few deeper chocolate-brown lowlights woven from the roots to the ends, so the grey merges with no regrowth line, soft and low contrast

review.note: The front view shows the blended grey more clearly than the back view.

name: Natural silver with a toning gloss
client: Your natural grey and white, with a clear, silvery shine that softens yellow tones.
stylist: A toning gloss over natural grey and white hair to remove yellow and add shine. A good finish for a grey grow-out.
prompt_spec: bring out the grey I already have, preserving its amount and distribution and my existing pigmented base; a cool toning gloss reduces yellowing on existing grey and white strands and adds shine

name: Silver-white babylights
client: Fine silver lights that blend with your natural grey for a soft, sparkling finish while you grow it out.
stylist: Fine silver babylights through a natural grey base to even out the pattern of white and grey, then a cool toner.
prompt_spec: natural grey and white hair with fine bright silver-white babylights woven from close to the roots to the ends, softening the darker strands, silver-white lights blending with my existing base and whatever natural grey I already have, with no hard lines

name: Light brown grey coverage
client: A natural-looking light brown chosen to cover grey from root to tip. Very resistant grey can need extra steps.
stylist: Permanent colour to cover grey in a neutral light brown, with the roots refreshed at each visit. A neutral shade gives the most even result.
prompt_spec: an even neutral light brown all over, roots, mids and ends the same natural brown with no grey showing at the roots, soft and healthy-looking

name: Chocolate brown grey coverage
client: A rich, warm chocolate brown chosen to cover grey evenly.
stylist: Permanent colour to cover grey in a rich neutral-warm chocolate brown, with root touch-ups. Ensure the lengths are refreshed with care.
prompt_spec: a rich neutral-warm chocolate brown all over, roots, mids and ends the same glossy brown with no grey showing at the roots, even and natural

name: Soft black grey coverage
client: A soft, natural black chosen to cover grey evenly.
stylist: Permanent colour to cover grey in a soft black. Regrowth shows more on dark hair, so plan root visits.
prompt_spec: a soft natural black all over, roots, mids and ends the same, deep and even with no grey showing at the roots, glossy

name: Pastel pink
client: A soft, candy pink all over on very light hair. It is a bold change that needs regular touch-ups.
stylist: Pastel pink over a fully lightened base. Pastels fade quickly, so plan colour-safe care and refreshes.
prompt_spec: a soft pastel pink all over, with the roots, mids and ends all the same light candy pink, even and glossy, with no darker roots and no banding

name: Rose gold
client: A blonde with a warm copper-pink glow, soft rather than bright.
stylist: A copper-pink gloss over a lifted blonde base. Fades towards a soft blonde, so plan refreshes.
prompt_spec: a rose gold all over, roots, mids and ends the same light blonde with a warm copper-pink glow, soft and glossy

name: Lavender
client: A soft violet-lilac across the whole head on very light hair.
stylist: A pastel violet over a fully lightened base. Pastels fade quickly, so plan colour-safe care and refreshes.
prompt_spec: a soft lavender all over, with the roots, mids and ends all the same pale lilac, even and glossy, with no darker roots and no banding

name: Teal
client: A saturated blue-green all over, bold and bright.
stylist: A saturated teal over a lifted base. Blue-greens are strong when new, fade to a lighter aqua and can stain lightened hair, so plan how it will be removed or covered later.
prompt_spec: a saturated blue-green teal all over, with the roots, mids and ends all the same rich teal, vivid and glossy, with no darker roots and no banding

name: Cherry red
client: A saturated, blue-toned red from root to ends.
stylist: A cool, saturated red over a lifted base. Reds fade quickly and stain, so plan colour-safe care.
prompt_spec: a saturated blue-based cherry red all over, with the roots, mids and ends all the same rich red, vivid and glossy, with no darker roots and no banding

name: Midnight blue
client: A very dark blue that reads as near-black indoors and shows blue in daylight.
stylist: A deep blue over a base lightened enough for the blue to read; the warmth left in darker hair turns blue towards brown-black. Subtle and wearable, with a shift of colour in the light.
prompt_spec: a very dark midnight blue all over, roots, mids and ends the same deep blue that reads almost black, with a clear blue sheen in the light

name: Peach apricot
client: A soft peach-orange pastel across the whole head.
stylist: A pastel peach over a pale, evenly lightened base; the last trace of warmth suits peach. Pastels fade fast, so plan refreshes and colour-safe care.
prompt_spec: a soft peach apricot all over, with the roots, mids and ends all the same pastel peach-orange, even and glossy, with no darker roots and no banding

name: Plum violet
client: A rich purple-plum from root to ends.
stylist: A saturated plum over a base lightened enough for the violet to read; on a darker, warmer base it turns red-brown. Violet fades towards a muted purple, so plan glosses.
prompt_spec: a saturated purple plum violet all over, with the roots, mids and ends all the same deep rich plum, vivid and glossy, with no banding

name: Plum ombre ends
client: Your natural roots fade into rich plum at the ends. It is a bold colour that is easy to wear.
stylist: An ombre that keeps the natural root zone and lifts the lengths to carry a saturated plum at the ends. Grows out without a visible line.
prompt_spec: dark brown at the roots and mid-lengths, blending softly into a saturated purple-plum through the lower lengths and ends, vivid and glossy

name: Peach and rose gold colour melt
client: A soft glow that melts from warm blonde through rose gold to peach at the ends.
stylist: Melt a strawberry blonde root into rose gold and peach ends over a lightened base. Pastel pink-orange tones fade fast, so plan refreshes.
prompt_spec: warm strawberry-blonde roots melting smoothly into a warm pink rose gold through the mid-lengths and a soft peach apricot at the ends, no lines, a continuous pastel glow

name: Lavender ombre on blonde
client: Cool blonde that softly fades into lavender at the ends.
stylist: An ombre from ash blonde to a pastel lavender at the ends over lightened lengths. Pastels fade fast, so plan refreshes.
prompt_spec: dark blonde at the roots, then cool ash blonde through the mid-lengths fading smoothly into soft pastel lavender at the ends, a clear gradient with no hard line

name: Grey blending for short hair
client: Soft light and deeper brown strands that blend with your grey on short hair, so the grey looks natural rather than covered.
stylist: Fine lights and lowlights through the top, and through the sides where the hair is long enough to weave, blending the grey instead of covering it. Low-contrast and easy to grow out.
prompt_spec: short brown hair with my own natural grey, if any, in its existing amount and distribution, with fine light-brown strands and a few deeper mocha strands through the top that merge with the grey, soft and low contrast, on the existing short haircut

name: Natural brown grey coverage
client: A natural, even brown chosen to cover grey on short hair.
stylist: Permanent colour in a neutral brown to cover grey, with regular root touch-ups. A neutral shade reads most naturally on a short cut.
prompt_spec: an even natural mocha brown across the whole head, roots, top and sides the same, with no grey showing, soft and natural-looking, on the existing short haircut

name: Soft black grey coverage for short hair
client: A soft, natural black chosen to cover grey evenly on short hair.
stylist: Permanent colour to cover grey in a soft black; a shade a little softer than the original natural colour keeps it from looking flat. Regrowth shows sooner on short dark hair, so plan root visits.
prompt_spec: a soft natural black across the whole head, roots, top and sides the same, with no grey showing, deep and even, on the existing short haircut

name: Translucent grey blend
client: A see-through brown tone that softens grey instead of covering it. Some grey still shows and regrowth stays gentle.
stylist: A translucent deposit over the whole head that tones down grey without full coverage, leaving a natural salt-and-pepper. Choose a shade at or a little lighter than the natural brown so it does not look flat.
prompt_spec: short brown hair with my own natural grey, if any, in its existing amount and distribution, the grey softened to a gentle silvery brown with some grey still showing, a natural salt-and-pepper look with no flat dyed effect, on the existing short haircut

name: Bright platinum blonde
client: A bright, near-white blonde across the whole head. It is a big change that needs regular toning and root visits to stay clean.
stylist: Full lightening to a pale, even base, then a toner for a clean platinum. On short hair the lightener sits on the scalp, so check the scalp first, and plan regrowth care and bond protection.
prompt_spec: a bright, clean platinum blonde across the whole head, roots, top and sides the same pale near-white blonde with no yellow, even and smooth, the eyebrows and any beard left their natural colour, on the existing short haircut

name: Caramel tips
client: A lighter caramel finish on the tips of the top, with the sides left natural.
stylist: Painted caramel on the ends of the top section only, with the sides left natural. Soft grow-out; suits a textured cut.
prompt_spec: natural mocha brown on the sides and at the roots, with warm caramel-brown painted on the tips of the top, the lighter tips catching the light, soft and blended, on the existing short haircut

name: Sandy blonde tips
client: Sandy blonde tips on the top, with the sides and roots left natural for a lived-in contrast.
stylist: Painted and wrapped sections on the top tips for stronger lift, in a muted sandy blonde. Leave the sides natural and tone to avoid brass.
prompt_spec: natural chocolate-brown at the roots and sides, with muted sandy blonde painted on the tips of the top, softly contrasting, on the existing short haircut

name: Soft golden highlights
client: A few soft golden-brown highlights that add light and texture to short hair.
stylist: Foiled weaves through the top in a soft golden brown, kept subtle on a short cut. Suits clients who want a gentle lift.
prompt_spec: natural mocha brown across the whole head, with soft golden-brown highlights woven through the top only, the shorter sides left natural, subtle and warm, adding light and texture, on the existing short haircut

name: Deeper chocolate-brown lowlights
client: Deeper brown strands that add depth and shape to lighter brown hair.
stylist: Fine chocolate-brown lowlights through the top, and the sides where the hair is long enough, to add depth and break up flat colour. Low upkeep.
prompt_spec: natural neutral light brown across the whole head, with fine deeper chocolate-brown strands through the top, adding depth and definition, subtle and natural, on the existing short haircut

name: Midnight blue on short hair
client: A very dark blue that reads as near-black indoors and shows blue in daylight.
stylist: A deep blue over a base lightened enough for the blue to read. On short hair the lightener sits on the scalp, so check the scalp first; regrowth shows quickly.
prompt_spec: a very dark midnight blue across the whole head, roots, top and sides the same deep blue that reads almost black, with a clear blue sheen in the light, on the existing short haircut
